cicd.description: Tests run automatically on every change. Builds are reproducible from version control.
cicd.name: CI and CD

data.description: Ingest is scheduled and logged. Schemas are recorded for the main sources.
data.name: Data

governance.description: Every production model has an owner and a validation record. Approval is a named step.
governance.name: Governance

monitoring.description: Drift and performance are tracked against a baseline. Alerts go to a named owner.
monitoring.name: Monitoring

serving.description: The serving version is written down. Restarts are manual.
serving.name: Serving

training.description: Experiments are comparable across runs. The best run can be reproduced from its record.
training.name: Training
